text.text: Capstone buildings on green bases, seen from the north-east.
Looking west along the line of capstone buildings.

Land for homes grows from 2.53 ha to 4.24 ha, so homes get more room: people per hectare of housing fall by a third, from 3,648 to 2,476. Each capstone building has 80 homes, from one to three bedrooms, for 244 people.
Views of the housing. Each number matches a marker on the drawing above.
Looking north from the old lanes to the new homes on the port land.
From a balcony: planted terraces looking out to the sea.
